summary: One real transactional email was sent with @nitrosend/cli 0.3.9 from a self-hosted Nitrosend sender to a Nitrosend proof inbox; the provider accepted it and issued a signed public receipt. Six earlier signups were auto-held by account screening (sending_paused), which also blocked sender activation; one reproducible CLI defect (--dry-run reports Valid:true for a send the server rejects) was found and documented.

observations.claim: CLI and runtime versions used for the send
The CLI send was accepted by the provider and left the account
observations.command: nitrosend send --to proof@dogfood.nitrosend.net --subject 'First send via the Nitrosend CLI' --body 'Hello from the Nitrosend CLI. This is a single transactional proof-of-work send.' --idempotency-key cli-first-send-001
observations.result: exit 0; message id 5161538; status sent; sent_at 2026-10-21T19:24:36.768Z; provider_id 010001a15fec2f63-9fb4bf04-c5b9-4db1-93bc-e187f4565bcb-000000

observations.claim: The send is independently visible in the account's own message list
observations.result: one record: to=proof@dogfood.nitrosend.net, subject='First send via the Nitrosend CLI', status=sent, sent_at 2026-10-21T19:24:36.768Z, failure_code null

observations.claim: The provider issued a signed public receipt for the send, and it resolves
observations.result: publisher nitrosend; venue nitrosend; subject 'Nitrosend CLI service - cli.send'; occurred 21 Oct 2026, 19:24 UTC; recorded 2026-10-21T19:24:38Z; digest sha256:b91b8609cd78fc497fdbe8852488ec79d924a279268504e4929efd6cfcae2eda

observations.claim: The receipt states plainly what it does not establish, so the limitation is recorded rather than glossed over
observations.result: page states 'only its digest was supplied' and 'This record does not prove the receipt content because only its digest was supplied'; notary counter-seal 'Key not published'; verifier hash-only

observations.claim: The account used for the send has a verified hosted sender and a completed Brand Kit
observations.result: sid e02afe732103a337117db188, company 'Ilya Web Development', effective_from_email hello@ilya-web-development.nitrosend.net, from_email_domain_status verified, complete true, onboarding_state.first_send.completed true at 2026-10-21T19:24:36Z, setup_center.cards.connect_agent.client 'Nitrosend CLI' acknowledged

observations.claim: Exactly one email has ever been sent from this account
observations.result: lifetime.email_sent = 1, lifetime.sms_sent = 0; account id 13078, created_at 2026-10-21T19:20:29.290Z, tier free

observations.claim: Six earlier signups were auto-held by account screening, and the hold blocks sender activation, not just sending
observations.command: GET https://api.nitrosend.com/v1/my/delivery/status and GET https://api.nitrosend.com/v1/my/account for each of the six accounts
observations.result: accounts 13064 (paused 17:19:20.130Z), 13065 (17:30:57.673Z), 13072 (18:43:07.330Z), 13073 (18:45:00.538Z), 13076 (19:09:38.966Z) all admission_status=denied, blocking_control account_status, retryable false; account 13078 admission_status=allowed

observations.claim: The hold is applied at signup, not by a later policy change, and the pause timestamp equals the account creation timestamp to the second
observations.result: account 13065 created_at 2026-10-21T17:30:57.616Z vs sending_pause.occurred_at 2026-10-21T17:30:57.673Z; the API's own detail text reads 'Sending is paused while we review recent activity on this account'

observations.claim: nitrosend send --dry-run reports Valid:true and exit 0 for a send the server rejects with exit 65 on a held account
observations.command: nitrosend send --to neutral-probe@example.com --subject t --body t --dry-run  -> 'Valid: true', exit 0 ; identical command without --dry-run -> 'Error: Sending is paused for this account', exit 65
observations.result: dry-run never contacts the server, so an account-level admission decision is invisible to it while it still reports validity

observations.claim: The same hold is reachable through the REST and MCP send paths and through sender activation
observations.command: POST https://api.nitrosend.com/v1/my/messages; nitrosend mcp tools call nitro_send_message; POST https://api.nitrosend.com/v1/my/brands/<sid>/prepare_sending
observations.result: {"code":"sending_paused","message":"Sending is paused for this account","error_code":"sending_paused","retryable":false}; prepare_sending returns HTTP 422 with the same body

observations.claim: GitHub star on the CLI repository is in place for the account performing the send
The screening behaviour was reported to the maintainers on a public tracker
observations.result: issue https://github.com/nitrosend/cli/issues/6 opened 2026-10-21T18:41:55Z, state open, describing the auto-pause with exact timestamps and error bodies

limitations: The public receipt proves a publisher, a venue, a subject and a time, but its own page states that only the digest was supplied and that it does not prove the receipt content; the send itself is evidenced by the provider's own message record (id 5161538, status sent, provider_id).
The five held accounts and the two e-mail domains used for the successful signup are recorded here, but no API key, token or password appears in this file or in report.md.

The recipient address proof@dogfood.nitrosend.net is the provider's own proof inbox and is named in this file as part of the reproducible send command; no message body content is reproduced beyond the one-line body that was sent.
